summary: The Southern Company filed an 8-K reporting the upsize and pricing of two convertible senior notes offerings: $725 million of Series 2026A 2.125% notes due 2027 and $1.65 billion of Series 2026B 3.50% notes due 2029, upsized by $75M and $150M respectively, with greenshoe options up to an additional $108.75M and $247.5M. Concurrently, the company repurchased ~$369 million of its Series 2024A 4.50% convertible notes in privately negotiated transactions. The proceeds likely fund the repurchase and general corporate purposes, reducing existing convertible debt overhang. Watch for pricing terms, conversion premiums, and any impact on diluted share count.
